cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: This is the second session of split-adjusted trading after a 1-for-150 reverse split, which began at the open on 2026-09-28. The split followed a month in which the issuer's Aug-21 ATM with Pacific Century took Class A shares from 2,955,935 to 199,805,935 by 2026-09-22. Today's fall came mostly overnight (gap -18.3%, intraday -3.7%), with no new filing or release since the 2026-09-25 13D/A.

evidence.claim: The ATM sales agreement with Pacific Century Securities was entered on 2026-08-21 for up to $35,280,213.01 of Class A stock, under S-3 333-281820 (effective 2024-09-06)
2,955,935 Class A shares were outstanding at 2026-08-21. The company had already sold 2,775,000 shares under the April 2 prospectus for about $30.9M net
A 1-for-150 reverse split took effect 2026-09-21, with post-split trading from the 2026-09-28 open. There were 199,805,935 Class A shares pre-split at 2026-09-22 (about 1,332,040 post-split)
A 13D/A holder complains of dilution from new share issuance and 150M+ shares of volume on 2026-09-22

pipeline.next_dated_event: The ATM can sell every session, including 2026-09-30. The JoyPak acquisition is expected to close on or about 2026-10-15, outside the window. The next earnings date is only a Zacks estimate (2026-11-06).
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: An 8-K before the 2026-09-30 open saying the Aug-21 ATM is exhausted or terminated, or a new share count showing the $35.28M cap is used up.

positioning_check: Short interest was 882,291 shares at the 2026-09-15 settlement, pre-split, which is about 5,900 post-split shares. It was up 525.6% on 141,023 at 08-31, with 1.0 days to cover on 36.5M average daily volume (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/CTNT/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). That settlement predates the split and most of the dilution, and FINRA publishes about eight business days late, so the position carried into this fall cannot be observed. The float is about 1.33M post-split shares at 09-22 and probably higher since. Nasdaq's insider summary shows no open-market insider trades in 3 or 12 months. There is no options market, so there is no skew.

findings.finding: The Aug-21 $35.28M ATM with Pacific Century Securities is still open. The issuer has used it to multiply the share count about 67x in a month, and it can sell into the 2026-09-30 session exactly as the same issuer's previous ATM kept selling after its April reverse split.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An ATM draws daily through the sales agent, with no further filing needed. The shelf is effective (S-3 333-281820, declared effective 2024-09-06, 3-year life), and the prospectus supplement covers Class A stock regardless of the split. The disclosed selling rate has been continuous (Aug-21 to Sep-22, 2.96M to 199.8M shares). The previous program did not stop at its split either: the April 24 8-K shows 355M pre-split shares (about 1.78M post-split) sold by 4/23, and the 424B5 of 8/24 shows 2,775,000 sold under that prospectus in total. So about 1.0M more post-split shares were sold after the April split.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: During ATM-driven falls this name's next closes were: 4/17 -42.1, 4/20 -18.2, 4/21 -11.1, 4/23 +30.3, 4/27 -14.3, 4/29 (first post-split day) -3.6; in September, 9/14 -58.9, 9/15 -32.3, 9/16 +7.1, 9/24 0.0, 9/28 -21.4. Across the 24 comparable falls the median is -6.45% with 25% up (sealed baseline).
findings.why_not_priced: The price has taken the dilution already disclosed (the 199.8M pre-split share count to 09-22). It has not taken sales made after that date, or sales still to come, because no filing shows them. The remaining ATM capacity cannot be sourced from here. If the market had priced the supply as finished, the second post-split session would not have gapped -18% on ordinary volume. A stock whose seller was done would look like the post-April-split tape from May onward, which had no ≥15% falls for four months.
findings.independence: Two sources point the same way. The 424B5 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1951667/000110465926100368/tm2623652d1_424b5.htm) and the April 24 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1951667/000110465926048601/tm2612177d1_8k.htm) together show the prior program kept selling after its split. The 2026-09-25 13D/A records a holder complaining of dilution and 150M+ shares of volume on 09-22. Daily bars (Yahoo chart, truncated in the URL at 2026-09-29 00:00 UTC) show about 518M pre-split-equivalent shares traded on 09-25 against 199.8M outstanding at 09-22.

outside_window.finding: The 06-30 10-Q shows $80.3M of stockholders' equity (cash only $2.1M; the rest is $41.1M in investment-deposit receivables and $30.0M in loans to third parties) against a post-split market cap of about $4M. That is a 'cheap' argument with no mechanism and no clock, and the quality of those receivables is unverified.
The $788,000 cash acquisition of JoyPak Supply LLC is expected to close on or about 2026-10-15.

Takeover Time 2026 LLC (0.92% at 09-22 per its 13D/A) says it will seek to replace the CEO and win a board seat. There is no dated meeting or consent, and the stake is too small to be a buyer that matters.

baseline_tension: The finding agrees with this name's own history of falls (median -6.45%, 25% up) and its extreme volatility. It cuts against the cross-section band prior (+0.27% for -25..-15) and against the 1.04x volume reading, although that ratio is measured against a 20-day median inflated by dilution days.
